title: Choose a language and run code
summary: Choose one of six languages for DSA. Run JavaScript here or use clearly named local tools for C, C++, Python, C#, and Java examples.
introduction: You need only one language to begin. Think of six people writing the same recipe in different words: the cooking steps stay the same. These tabs let you learn one set of DSA ideas in a language that suits you.
learningObjectives: Choose one language instead of learning six at once
Save a complete example with the right file name
Match each language with its local run command

blocks.text: If you are new to programming, JavaScript is a convenient first choice because its examples can run in this site's browser playground. You can return to the other tabs later.

Each tab contains a complete little program. A **compiler** translates a program before it runs. An **interpreter** runs a program through a language tool. Both are separate programs on your computer when used locally.
You can read every example without an account. C, C++, Python, C#, and Java tabs show code to copy into your own tools. JavaScript examples can run right here in your browser.

Build language basics with the existing tutorials: [JavaScript](/tutorials/javascript), [C](/tutorials/c), [C++](/tutorials/cpp), [Python](/tutorials/python), [C#](/tutorials/csharp), or [Java](/tutorials/java). Learn variables, if checks, loops, and functions, then follow the DSA examples.

items: Choose a tab and read only that version for now.
For JavaScript, choose Try it to open the playground, then choose Run and read the console output. For another language, save the code in the file listed below.
Open a terminal in the folder containing the file. A terminal is a window where you type commands for your computer.
Use the command for your language. The program adds 4, 7, and 2, so it should print 13.

rows: C11 with GCC or compatible compiler
C++17 with G++ or compatible compiler
`python main.py` (often `python3 main.py` on macOS or Linux)
`dotnet new console -n DsaPractice` once, then replace Program.cs and use `dotnet run --project DsaPractice`

blocks.text: After compiling C or C++, run `./main` on macOS or Linux, or `.\main.exe` in Windows PowerShell. Compile and run C and C++ separately because the example output file has the same name.

Run the C# project-creation command from a folder where DsaPractice does not already exist. Create it only once. For later lessons, replace that project's Program.cs, then run the same project again. The installed SDK chooses its available target version.

You can also [download the complete six-language DSA examples](/downloads/dsa-six-languages.zip). Extract (unzip) the folder first, then read README.md for the commands. Open the source file for the lesson and language you chose.

Choose one tab. All six programs do the same task and print the same result. JavaScript can run here. The other languages need the separate local tools in [Language setup](/tutorials/data-structures-algorithms/language-setup).

blocks.title: Choose a language and run code example

variants.caption: Run this JavaScript in the browser playground, or save main.js and use Node.js.
Use a separate local C11 compiler. Save this complete program as main.c; see Language setup.
Use a separate local C++17 compiler. Save this complete program as main.cpp; see Language setup.
Use a separate local Python 3 interpreter. Save this complete program as main.py; see Language setup.
Use a separate local .NET 8 or newer console project. Replace Program.cs with this complete program.
Use a separate local JDK 17 or newer. Save this complete program as Main.java; see Language setup.

blocks.text: The printed answer is the same in every language. Lines such as #include and public class Main set up the language's program shape. You can keep that outer shape while changing the small task inside.
Check the small and tricky cases

If the terminal says a command is not found, that local language tool is missing or is not on the command search path. Use the named tool's official setup guide, reopen the terminal, and try its version command. Nothing needs to be installed into this website.

Java needs the exact file name Main.java because the public class is Main. C# examples use top-level statements: they belong directly in Program.cs, with any helper classes after the statements. Do not wrap the whole example inside another Main method.
Python uses indentation to group steps. Keep the leading spaces when copying. C, C++, C#, and Java use braces for groups. A missing brace or quote can stop a program before it prints anything.

items: Change the final number from 2 to 5 in your chosen program, save the file, and run it again.
The output should be 16. For C, C++, and Java, run the compile command again after each edit so you do not execute an older build.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Copy one complete language tab at a time. Pasting all six versions into one file mixes languages and cannot make one valid program.
